ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 85-90% high-intensity white pixels and 10-15% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the edges and center.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white field across both lobes. Continuous black pigmentation band along the entire trailing edge. A distinct, vertically elongated black patch is centered below the median notch. Scattered small, dark circular and semi-circular spots (points) are distributed across the white planar surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 35-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes varying between 4 and 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, sweeping from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark-pixel circular and semi-circular annular rings (clusters) scattered across the high-intensity white surface area of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense biological encrustations (yellow-brown barnacles) are present at the far lateral tips (corners) of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique large black rectangular-shaped patch extending vertically from the median notch downwards towards the base of the fluke.
